thread:
bob_customer: We're seeing the rerank endpoint return 400 and zeroed scores for a subset of requests since 08:12 UTC. Error message: "Model ID not found or deprecated". Happening across two tenants.

alice_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact request (headers + body) and a request id if you have one?

bob_customer: here's a stripped curl (tenant header redacted):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "X-Tenant: acme-corp" \
  -d '{"model":"rerank-prod","queries":["q1","q2"],"candidates":[["a","b"]]}'

Response: HTTP/1.1 400
{"error":"DeprecatedModelId: model rerank-legacy-2 not available","scores":[0,0]}

alice_support: thanks — escalating to oncall, linking thread. @carol_oncall do you have time to look?

carol_oncall: looking. can you confirm the model in the request is the alias or the concrete model id? alias looks like "rerank-prod" which should point to rerank-2024-v2.

bob_customer: we use alias "rerank-prod" in prod config. hadn't changed it recently.

carol_oncall: pulling alias mapping from registry... hmm registry says "rerank-prod -> rerank-2024-v2" since 03:00 UTC. but routing logs show a few requests routed to rerank-legacy-2 and then failed.

dan_infra: pinging edge cache infra. we have an alias cache in the routing plane with 60s TTL. I see an out-of-order alias update at 02:59:53 where alias briefly pointed to rerank-legacy-2 due to a rollback script run in the deploy window. the registry update was applied but the routing cache missed the latest write because the update path didn't bump the cache version header.

alice_support: so that matches the customer's timeframe. what caused the rollback to point to legacy?

carol_oncall: ops performed a canary rollback for a different model and a script reused a variable, accidentally targeting the global alias. bad coincidence. requests hit edge cache which still had stale mapping for ~3 minutes. some of those concrete model ids had been removed from storage -> backend returned deprecated error and the client got 0 scores.

bob_customer: is there a mitigation? our users saw blank results for about 3 minutes.

dan_infra: mitigation done at 08:18 UTC: forced cache invalidation: 

POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/aliases/invalidate
body: {"alias":"rerank-prod"}

also rebounded alias with an atomic CAS update and added a temporary fallback in routing to prefer registry on cache-miss. customers should stop seeing errors after invalidation.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026.03.17-hotfix-alias-cas applied to routing-service at 08:20 UTC :tada:

carol_oncall: verified tail logs post-fix — no more requests to rerank-legacy-2. searched for 400/DeprecatedModelId across last 30m, spikes stop after 08:19.

alice_support: relaying to the customer: we fixed routing cache and aliased mapping, added hotfix to ensure alias updates are atomic, and invalidated caches. Apologies — white-glove follow-up and postmortem incoming.

eve_pm: follow-ups: (1) add stricter validation so that alias updates cannot reference deleted concrete ids, (2) add audit alert when alias changes are non-idempotent, (3) add docs note for tenants to prefer stable concrete ids for short windows during deploys.

bob_customer: thanks for fast triage. can you share a short timeline and root cause? we'll escalate internally.

alice_support: timeline: 02:59:53 UTC - accidental rollback script rebinds alias -> rerank-legacy-2 (3m window) 
03:02:00 UTC - some legacy model ids removed from storage -> backend returns DeprecatedModelId 
03:12:00 UTC - customer reports issue to support 
03:18:00 UTC - infra forced cache invalidate + CAS rebind 
03:20:00 UTC - hotfix deployed to routing service

root cause: non-atomic alias update + cached alias mapping in routing plane allowing a transient alias -> deleted-model mapping to persist. Also bad rollback script variable reuse.

alice_support: next steps: postmortem + action items assigned. I'll DM you the incident ticket and add you to the postmortem review. :thumbsup:

bob_customer: appreciated. will await the postmortem.

carol_oncall: adding ticket RN-4827 to track infra fix and rollout verification.

alice_support: closing thread for now, re-open if you see any recurrence.
